title: Antigravity Enchantment
description: A boots enchantment that reduces gravity and increases safe fall distance. Floatier jumps and softer landings.
body:
Antigravity is a custom boot enchantment that reduces player's gravity and increases your resistance.

Level I reduces gravity by 50% and Level II by 75%. It also increases safe fall distance by 3 blocks per level.

Note: Elytra will be easier to maneuver (softer landings, easier takeoffs).

Custom enchantment applied via loot, trading, enchanting table, or the `/loot give` command:

```/loot give @s loot antigravity_enchantment:1```

Can appear in random **structure chests** or via **villager trades**.

Works like a regular enchantment — apply it to **boots only**.

Fully multiplayer-compatible: **Server-only** datapack. Players don't need to install it.
